verdict.rationale: Reducto documents structured JSON output 'ready for LLMs', and its CLI writes markdown parse files, with each element typed, so the LLM-ready output part of the story is delivered. Nothing in the evidence documents stripping repeated headers, footers or other page furniture. missing for 10: documented removal or filtering of repeated headers/footers and page furniture, independent or hands-on corroboration of output cleanliness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I get clean markdown/JSON designed for LLM consumption, with noise like repeated headers and page furniture stripped

citations.quote: You will parse a document and get back structured JSON ready for LLMs, downstream extraction, or any other processing step in your pipeline.
It converts documents into structured JSON with text, tables, figures, layout, and formatting
The CLI writes `<filename>.parse.md` next to each input file.
Each element includes its type, page position, and confidence score.
